assertions.claim: HP announced 4,000 to 6,000 job cuts in November 2025, which were widely attributed to AI-related workforce reductions.
assertions.evidence: The host states, 'We saw thousands and thousands of white collar jobs disappear, such as HP announcing 4,000 to 6,000 job cuts.'

assertions.claim: Block is undergoing a 40% workforce reduction as part of its transition to an AI-driven organizational structure.
assertions.evidence: The host notes that Jack Dorsey 'recently made news with the 40% layoffs at Block' in the context of introducing the essay on the new AI org chart.

assertions.claim: Tailwind CSS CEO Adam Wathan stated that 75% of the company's engineering team was laid off due to the impact of AI on their business.
assertions.source: Adam Wathan (via GitHub comment cited in transcript)
assertions.evidence: CEO Adam Wan responded, 'I totally see the value in the feature... but the reality is that 75% of the people on our engineering team lost their jobs here yesterday because of the brutal impact AI has had on our business.'

assertions.claim: Coinbase announced a 14% reduction in its workforce, resulting in approximately 700 of its 5,000 employees being laid off.
assertions.evidence: Brian Armstrong tweeted the email he sent to all employees at Coinbase announcing a 14% reduction in the team. That means about 700 of 5,000 people will be laid off.

assertions.claim: Meta laid off 8,000 people and is installing software on US employees' computers to capture mouse movements, clicks, and keystrokes for AI training data.
assertions.evidence: Dan Shipper wrote: 'Meta just laid off 8,000 people and is installing software on US employees' computers to capture mouse movements, clicks, and keystrokes for a higher-quality source of AI training data on advanced knowledge work.'

assertions.claim: Atlassian announced 10% layoffs in March, an event that marked the end of a mini-recovery and preceded the stock heading into a year-to-date low in mid-April.
assertions.evidence: The host explained: 'In March, they announced 10% layoffs, and that announcement actually marked the end of a mini recovery over the previous 2 weeks. The stock actually headed into a year-to-date low in mid-April.'
